name: Cinderwake
storyline: The ash-plains wake at dusk, and the burnt rise from the ground to swarm whoever stands on them until dawn. Hold the night as one of three heroes, the Emberwright with her lantern-topped staff, the Stoker with his shovel, or the Cairnslinger with her stones, while ever worse things walk out of the ash. Survive the plains and the road leads down into the Steamfen, a drowned kiln city in a steaming marsh where the nagas hunt in the water.
summary: Cinderwake is a free survivors-style action RPG played in the web browser, with no download and no install. Pick one of three heroes (the Emberwright, a fire mage; the Stoker, a melee bruiser; or the Cairnslinger), whose skills cast on their own while you move and dodge. Hold the Ash Plains against swarms of the burnt until dawn, choosing new skills and upgrades at every level, then go down into the Steamfen. Real-time 3D graphics with WebGPU and a WebGL fallback.
